title: Trinkets Totem
description: This datapack adds a chest/charm slot for your Totem of Undying, allowing you to equip it as a trinket.
body:
# Trinkets Totem

This data pack allows you to open a Trinket slot for your Totem of Undying.

![Main image](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1c9a262eb28e737abe90072cd10a15c08b7ed244.jpeg)

## About

Trinkets is a **library** mod that provides extra equipment slots. However, out of the box, it provides no visible slots for vanilla items. This datapack enables the functionality for the Totem of Undying by assigning **chest/charm** slot.

@[Patbox](https://modrinth.com/user/L8RLwrF2):
> Trinkets by itself is invisible if nothing else uses it. You either need some mods that depend on it or to use a datapack.

## Installation
Simply drop the _.jar_ file into your _mods_ folder or _.zip_ into _datapacks_.

## Requirements
[Trinkets Updated](https://modrinth.com/project/XaT8sLP6) (or [Trinkets](https://modrinth.com/project/5aaWibi9)) must be installed.

## License
I am not the original author of this configuration. This logic is based on the repository for [Trinkets Updated](https://github.com/Patbox/trinkets), which is a fork of the original [Trinkets](https://github.com/emilyploszaj/trinkets).

## Known Issues
Incompatible with [Polymer](https://modrinth.com/project/xGdtZczs) and [Polymer Patch for Trinkets Updated](https://modrinth.com/project/G8hlgtEk).
> Polymer patch currently doesn't work with due to limitations.
